definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese pleated trousers or skirt.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}で{袴|はかま}を{着|き}た。
examples.english: I wore hakama at the graduation ceremony.

notes:
{袴|はかま} is traditional Japanese attire.

USES:
- Graduation ceremonies (especially for women)
- Martial arts (kendo, aikido)
- Tea ceremony
- Shinto priests

TYPES:
- {馬乗|うまの}り{袴|はかま}: divided hakama (trousers)
- {行灯|あんどん}{袴|はかま}: undivided hakama (skirt)
